verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a conventional flag-and-subcommand CLI (`skills add/use/find/update/remove` with `--skill`, `-a`, `-g`, `-y`) plus keyword search. Nothing shows the product interpreting natural-language commands itself. Auto-detecting a coding agent and switching to non-interactive mode makes the CLI agent-friendly, but the natural-language understanding comes from the host agent, so this is an adjacent feature rather than the capability the story asks for.
